targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT instance_id) AS value FROM heartbeats WHERE day >= current_date - interval '7 days'
SELECT count(DISTINCT instance_id) AS value FROM heartbeats WHERE day >= current_date - interval '30 days'
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM instance_meta) + COALESCE((SELECT sum(count) FROM expired_instances), 0) AS value
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM instance_meta WHERE first_seen >= current_date - interval '7 days'

WITH days AS (SELECT generate_series(date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz)::date, date_trunc('day', $__timeTo()::timestamptz)::date, interval '1 day')::date AS day) SELECT d.day::timestamptz AS time, COALESCE(count(DISTINCT h.instance_id), 0) AS active FROM days d LEFT JOIN heartbeats h ON h.day = d.day GROUP BY d.day ORDER BY d.day

WITH days AS (SELECT generate_series(date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz)::date, date_trunc('day', $__timeTo()::timestamptz)::date, interval '1 day')::date AS day) SELECT d.day::timestamptz AS time, COALESCE(count(im.instance_id), 0) AS new_instances FROM days d LEFT JOIN instance_meta im ON im.first_seen = d.day GROUP BY d.day ORDER BY d.day

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (instance_id) instance_id, payload FROM heartbeats WHERE day >= current_date - interval '7 days' ORDER BY instance_id, day DESC) SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE (payload->>'platform') = 'docker')  AS docker, count(*) FILTER (WHERE (payload->>'platform') = 'bare')    AS bare, count(*) FILTER (WHERE (payload->>'platform') = 'k8s')     AS k8s, count(*) FILTER (WHERE (payload->>'platform') = 'desktop') AS desktop, count(*) FILTER (WHERE (payload->>'platform') = 'unknown') AS unknown FROM latest

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (instance_id) instance_id, payload FROM heartbeats WHERE day >= current_date - interval '7 days' ORDER BY instance_id, day DESC) SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE (payload->>'os_family') = 'linux')   AS linux, count(*) FILTER (WHERE (payload->>'os_family') = 'darwin')  AS darwin, count(*) FILTER (WHERE (payload->>'os_family') = 'windows') AS windows, count(*) FILTER (WHERE (payload->>'os_family') = 'unknown') AS unknown FROM latest

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (instance_id) instance_id, payload FROM heartbeats WHERE day >= current_date - interval '7 days' ORDER BY instance_id, day DESC), per_bucket AS (SELECT (payload->'counts'->>'accounts') AS bucket, count(*) AS instances FROM latest GROUP BY 1) SELECT b.bucket, COALESCE(p.instances, 0) AS instances FROM (VALUES ('0',0),('1',1),('2-5',2),('6-10',3),('11-50',4),('51-200',5),('201+',6)) AS b(bucket, ord) LEFT JOIN per_bucket p USING (bucket) ORDER BY b.ord

panels.title: Version distribution (latest snapshot per instance, last 7d)

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (instance_id) instance_id, payload FROM heartbeats WHERE day >= current_date - interval '7 days' ORDER BY instance_id, day DESC), counted AS (SELECT (payload->>'version') AS version, count(*) AS instances FROM latest GROUP BY 1) SELECT version, instances FROM counted ORDER BY string_to_array(regexp_replace(version, '[+-].*$', ''), '.')::int[] DESC NULLS LAST, version DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Feature adoption (% of active instances, last 7d)

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (instance_id) instance_id, payload FROM heartbeats WHERE day >= current_date - interval '7 days' ORDER BY instance_id, day DESC), feats AS (SELECT key AS feature, count(*) FILTER (WHERE value::text = 'true') AS enabled, count(*) AS total FROM latest, jsonb_each_text(payload->'features') GROUP BY key) SELECT feature, CASE WHEN total = 0 THEN 0 ELSE enabled::float / total END AS pct FROM feats WHERE feature IN ('calendar','contacts','files','extensions','oauth_enabled','smime_enabled') ORDER BY pct DESC, feature

SELECT received_at, day, payload->>'version' AS version, payload->>'platform' AS platform, payload->>'os_family' AS os, payload->'counts'->>'accounts' AS accounts, payload->'counts'->>'extensions_installed' AS exts, payload->>'uptime_days' AS uptime_days FROM heartbeats ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 50
